name: feedback
description: One promise, due on day 1 at noon: the stub's intention turn posts the cat meme but the post is refused (destination-required) and marks the intention done. The scheduler queues one feedback wake in the same chain for the next tick, naming the refused call and the intention closed without delivery; the stub then posts through message.create. The feedback turn gets no feedback of its own.
